info.title: Sofa King server
info.description: The Sofa King media center server's HTTP interface: the API the Sofa King app uses under /api/v1 for live TV, recordings and media libraries, the admin API under /api/v1/admin, the player outputs under /output, the logo cache and the HDHomeRun emulation Plex reads. The admin portal under /admin is HTML and is not described here. Timestamps are UTC instants.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Public checks that take no token.

tags.name: Live TV
tags.description: The catalog and guide the app reads. Bearer: the API token.

tags.name: Playback
tags.description: Sessions that select a source and relay its media. Bearer: the API token; the media URLs take none.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Provider and source health. Bearer: the API token.

tags.name: Outputs
tags.description: The M3U playlist, XMLTV guide and player streams. Token: the output token as ?token= or a bearer, or the API bearer.

tags.name: HDHomeRun
tags.description: What Plex reads from an HDHomeRun tuner. No token; clients are admitted by address (SOFA_HDHR_ALLOW and the addresses allowed at run time).

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: The server, its sessions, candidates, guides and the lineup. Bearer: the admin token, or the API token when none is set.

tags.name: Policy
tags.description: The lineup policy and its runs. Bearer: the admin token.

tags.name: Plex
tags.description: Plex Live TV sync. Bearer: the admin token.

tags.name: Viewers
tags.description: Pairing a client to the server and the preferences each client keeps on it. Bearer: the API token, except the pairing claim, which takes none.

tags.name: Library
tags.description: Media libraries: folders of movies, shows and other videos under SOFA_MEDIA_DIR, which the server reads and never writes. The app's routes take the API token; /artwork takes none; the admin routes take the admin token.

tags.name: Recordings
tags.description: The DVR: recordings and the series rules that schedule them. Bearer: the API token.

tags.name: Hooks
tags.description: Calls from Sonarr, Radarr and other tools when files change, each queuing a library scan. A hook token from POST /api/v1/admin/tokens, or the API token, as a bearer, a Basic password or the X-MediaBrowser-Token or X-Emby-Token header.

tags.name: Watchlist
tags.description: The household's watchlist of library items and guide titles. Bearer: the API token.

readToken.description: A read token from POST /api/v1/admin/tokens; it opens the admin reads listed with it

hookToken.description: A hook token from POST /api/v1/admin/tokens; it opens the hooks and nothing else. Also accepted as a Basic password

mediaBrowserToken.name: X-MediaBrowser-Token
mediaBrowserToken.description: A hook token or SOFA_API_TOKEN, as Sonarr's and Radarr's Emby / Jellyfin connection sends its API key; X-Emby-Token works too

outputName.description: A named output: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

Error.description: An error: code, message and whether a retry may succeed.

dismissed.description: Taken off Continue watching by hand; the next play clears it.

children.description: A show's seasons (or episodes when it has no season folders), or a season's episodes.

unwatched.description: A show's or season's unwatched episodes.

playState.description: A movie's, episode's or video's watch state; null before it is started.

extra.description: An extra's kind; null for anything else. A client shows a kind it does not know as other.

tmdbId.description: A movie's or show's TMDB id, from its name, its .nfo or the TMDB match.

next.description: For a show, the episode to play next.

segments.description: Spans a player offers to skip, such as an episode's intro.

scrub.description: Thumbnails to show over the seek bar while scrubbing; null until the server has made them, or for a file under five minutes.

extras.description: A movie's or show's trailers, featurettes and other extras, trailers first.

related.description: For a movie, show or video, up to 12 others in its library that share its genres, the most shared first.

ScrubThumbnails.description: JPEG sheets of columns by rows tiles, left to right and then down. Tile n overall, on sheet n / (columns * rows), shows the file at n * intervalMs.

sheets.description: Each sheet's path under /artwork, with its ?v= version.

watched.description: Set by hand; wins over the position. The only field a show or season takes.

dismissed.description: True takes a movie, video or episode off Continue watching, false puts it back; either leaves its position and watched flag.

ClientProfile.description: What the player decodes as is.

audioCodecs.description: aac, ac3, eac3, mp3, opus, flac, dts, truehd

recordingId.description: A running or finished recording to play instead of an item.

audioIndex.description: An audio stream index from the item's tracks; the file's default when null.

subtitleIndex.description: A picture subtitle track from the item's subtitles to draw into the picture, which converts the stream. A text track or a recording answers 400.

startMs.description: Restart a converted stream here, under a new epoch.
Where in the item the HLS stream's time 0 is; 0 for direct play.

recordingId.description: Set, with an empty itemId, when the session plays a recording.

channelIds.description: Two to four different lineup channels, drawn left to right and top to bottom.

audio.description: The index in channelIds of the tile whose sound plays; it has a border.
Move the sound to this tile, restarting the stream under a new epoch.

hidden.description: Channel ids the client leaves out.

favorites.description: Starred channel ids, in the viewer's order.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.

favorites.description: Starred channel ids, in the household's order.

hidden.description: Channel ids the sharing devices leave out.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write; empty until a device first writes.

preferences.description: Null until the client saves some.

ownToken.description: Whether the client holds a token of its own from pairing; false means it uses SOFA_API_TOKEN.

TokenScope.description: api: a paired device's token for the app's routes; read: the admin reads a dashboard needs; hook: the inbound hooks under /api/v1/hooks.

clientId.description: The device an api token was paired to.

secret.description: Shown this once; the server keeps only a hash.

status.description: The last HTTP status; null when the target never answered.

hasSecret.description: Whether a webhook signing key or ntfy access token is set; the API never returns it.

url.description: http or https, with a host and no user name.

secret.description: Signs a webhook's body as X-SofaKing-Signature, or is ntfy's bearer token. Empty clears it.

value.description: A library ID, a show's item ID, a genre name or a lineup entry ID, by kind. A channel plays in timed slots only.

start.description: HH:MM in the server's time zone, on every slot or none.

id.description: Given by the server; ignored in a request.

VirtualBreaks.description: Breaks after an item: one item of source, then each slide. Null when they would air nothing.

everyMinutes.description: Minutes since the last break before another; 0 after every item.

slides.description: Image URLs fetched as each slide airs.

sessions.description: Live and library playback sessions open now.

updateAvailable.description: Whether a newer image is published; null until the update check has an answer.

id.description: The session's id while it played.

clientId.description: The paired device whose token opened it; null for the shared token and for players outside the app.

providerId.description: The provider a live session played from

mode.description: watch, preview, external or recording for live TV; direct, remux or transcode for VOD.

bytes.description: Bytes relayed to a live player; null for VOD.

bitrateKbps.description: The rate media went to the player over the last 10 seconds or so

stalls.description: Media requests the upstream refused or dropped before anything was answered

sourceSwitches.description: Moves to another source, on a failure or by hand

offerings.description: The entry's sources in failover order

status.description: A health status, or WITHDRAWN when no provider lists the source now

gracenoteId.description: The policy's Gracenote station id for the station

CreateLineupEntry.description: With channelId, the candidate's number, name, logo, group, sources and guide mapping are copied and any field here overrides them; without it, number and name are required.

UpdateLineupEntry.description: Absent fields keep their value; the clear flags remove optional values. Sending enabled clears autoDisabledAt and autoDisabledReason.

revision.description: The file's SHA-256, also the ETag

StationExplanation.description: The station the policy builds for a key, its pins, and every candidate that names the key or joins it, each taken, skipped or claimed with a reason.

SourceDocument.description: The source file as written: providers and guides as docs/live-tv.md describes them, with ${NAME} references left unexpanded.

SetupResult.description: A setup write: the file it wrote, the starter policy when it wrote one too, and that the server is restarting to read them.

policyPath.description: The starter policy file, when the write built one with starterPolicy=true

NamedOutput.description: A playlist and guide of some of the lineup: a channel is held when its group is one of groups, ignoring case, or its number or ID is one of channels.

HdhrAccessStatus.description: Who may reach the HDHomeRun emulation. open is true when every address is admitted (a loopback bind with no address configured or allowed).

allowed.description: Allowed from the portal or this API, kept in the database

refused.description: Up to 10 addresses refused since the start that are still refused, newest first

GuideMatch.description: A guide channel proposed for a station by name. confidence is 1 when the cleaned names are equal, less as they differ; proposals start at 0.6.

items.description: An IP literal or CIDR block

SaveTmdbToken.description: A TMDB API read access token or v3 API key.

items.description: Present items by kind: movie, show, season, episode or video.

scanOk.description: False when the last scan found the folder missing, or empty while the library held files.

unavailable.description: The folder was missing or empty, so nothing changed.

path.description: A file or folder, as the server names it or as SOFA_LIBRARY_PATH_MAP maps it.

libraries.description: The ids of the libraries whose scan was queued; empty when no library holds the path or the event changes no file.

ServarrEvent.description: The fields read from the Webhook connection's payload; the rest is ignored.

eventType.description: Download, Rename, EpisodeFileDelete, MovieFileDelete, SeriesDelete and MovieDelete queue a scan; any other event, Test included, queues nothing.

startsAt.description: The program's start; recording begins startPaddingSeconds earlier.

endsAt.description: The program's end; recording runs endPaddingSeconds later.

reason.description: Why a recording failed or was cut short: MISSED, NO_MEDIA, STOPPED, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED and the like.

conflict.description: A scheduled recording that overlaps more recordings than the server has playback slots.

commercials.description: How far the commercial scan of a kept recording got; null when the server does not look.

breaks.description: The commercial breaks found, in order.

startMs.description: From the start of the file.

usedBytes.description: What running and kept recordings use.

title.description: Matched against program titles, ignoring case.

channelId.description: Null records the title on every channel.

newOnly.description: Skip airings the guide marks previously shown.

keep.description: Finished recordings the rule keeps, newest first; 0 keeps all.

priority.description: The higher wins a playback slot when recordings conflict; a one-off outranks every rule.

match.description: A team or keyword rule's match; a title rule has none.

RuleMatch.description: What a rule matches. title: the rule's title. team: any term as a whole word in the title or episode title, in one of the categories (the rule's title and Sports when none are given). keyword: any term as a whole word in the title, episode title or description, in one of the categories when any is given.

title.description: Matched against program titles, ignoring case.

channelId.description: Null records the title on every channel.

newOnly.description: Skip airings the guide marks previously shown.

keep.description: Finished recordings the rule keeps, newest first; 0 keeps all.

priority.description: The higher wins a playback slot when recordings conflict; a one-off outranks every rule.

newOnly.description: Skip airings the guide marks previously shown.

keep.description: Finished recordings the rule keeps, newest first; 0 keeps all.

priority.description: The higher wins a playback slot when recordings conflict; a one-off outranks every rule.

title.description: The item's title as the library has it now, or the guide title, matched ignoring case.

channelId.description: A title on this channel only; null watches every channel.

item.description: Null when the library no longer holds the item.

next.description: A title's soonest airing that has not ended, within seven days.

channelId.description: A title on this lineup channel only.

post.summary: Claim a pairing code for a token of the device's own
post.description: The code comes from the admin portal's Devices page or POST /api/v1/admin/pairing-codes; it is live for ten minutes and works once, and five wrong claims void it. The answer is a new token for this clientId, which revokes the one it was paired with before; forgetting the device revokes it. No bearer token: 10 claims a minute per client address, then 429. A server without an API token answers an empty one.

429.description: Too many claims from this address

get.summary: The preferences this client last saved

put.description: Each list holds at most 1,000 distinct ids; an empty name or platform keeps the stored one. The answer is the stored document with the server's updatedAt.

get.summary: The household's shared favorites and hidden channels

put.summary: Replace the household's shared favorites and hidden channels
put.description: Each list holds at most 1,000 distinct ids. The answer is the stored document with the server's updatedAt.

get.summary: The catalog: the enabled lineup entries as channels
get.description: Carries an ETag; If-None-Match answers 304.

post.summary: Programs overlapping a window for up to 200 channels

get.summary: Movies, sports, kids' programs or premieres coming up on the enabled channels
get.description: Programs that have not ended and start within days, soonest first. A movie needs a Movie or Film category beside a film genre and no News or Sports one; sports and kids match their categories; new is a Premiere category or a new airing of a season's first episode.

get.summary: Each provider's import status and counts
Every source's health and manual-disable flag

patch.summary: Disable or enable a source by hand
patch.description: A disabled source is never selected or probed; sessions playing it move on.

post.summary: Open a preview or watch session
post.description: Picks the channel's first selectable source. Repeating a key returns the same session while it lives; a key reused with other parameters answers 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. At capacity the oldest preview, then an idle player session, yields; otherwise 429 CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED.

get.description: Moves the session to the next selectable source, with a new epoch, when the current one stopped being selectable.

patch.summary: Renew the lease; optionally change the intent
patch.description: A watch session expires 90 s after its last renewal, a preview 45 s. Send {} to renew alone.

get.summary: A playlist, segment, key or live TS stream of the session
get.description: No token: the random resource token authorizes it until the session ends or its epoch changes. An older epoch answers 410 STREAM_CHANGED; a source no longer selectable answers 503 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; more than 12 requests at once answer 429.

200.description: application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, video/mp2t or the resource's own type

get.summary: The enabled lineup as an M3U playlist
get.description: audio/x-mpegurl; tvg-id is the channel id, URLs use the request's Host. The stream suffix follows the protocol of the source the channel would play now; format=ts lists every stream as MPEG-TS. A channel with a Gracenote id in the policy carries tvc-guide-stationid, any other with a logo tvc-guide-art.

get.summary: The scheduled and running recordings as iCalendar
get.description: One event per recording over the window the DVR records, paddings included. A read token from POST /api/v1/admin/tokens works as ?token= too.
From three hours ago to days ahead; the server's runtime setting applies when days is absent.

get.summary: A named output's channels as an M3U playlist
get.description: As /output/playlist.m3u, holding only the output's groups and channels; url-tvg names the output's own guide. Stream URLs stay under /output/stream/.

get.summary: A named output's programs as XMLTV
get.description: As /output/guide.xml, holding only the output's groups and channels.

get.summary: Open a player session for the channel and stream it
get.description: An HLS source answers 302 to the session's playlist; an MPEG-TS source streams video/mp2t here, and with format=ts so does an HLS source, remuxed. The session is released 60 s after the last media request.
key is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the logo's source URL. Carries an ETag and Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400.

200.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG

get.summary: One page of a library's movies, shows or videos
Continue watching, Recently added per library, and the libraries
The movies and shows an id names
get.description: Every movie and show whose TMDB, TheTVDB or IMDb id is one of those given, in title order. At least one id; 400 for none or a malformed one.

get.summary: Titles holding q: movies, shows and videos, then episodes
get.description: Movies, shows and videos whose title holds q, then those with a cast member or director whose name holds it, then episodes by title. At most 50.

get.summary: An item with its seasons or episodes, a show's next episode and a file's tracks

put.summary: Record where playback stopped, or mark an item watched
put.description: A stop in the first 5% leaves the item where it was; one at 90% or later marks it watched. A show or season takes watched only, and marks every episode in it.

get.summary: A text subtitle track of the item as WebVTT
get.description: index is a subtitle track's index from the item: a stream of its file, or from 1000 a subtitle file beside it. Times are in the item's time. The first read extracts the stream, which reads the whole file; later reads serve the kept copy. A picture subtitle answers 415 SUBTITLE_NOT_TEXT.

post.summary: Play a library movie, episode or video
post.description: Direct play when the profile takes the file as is; otherwise HLS that FFmpeg remuxes or converts. At most SOFA_MAX_TRANSCODES convert at once.

patch.summary: Renew the session, or restart its converted stream
patch.description: A session lasts five minutes past its last renewal or media request.

get.description: The URL the session's descriptor names: the file itself with byte ranges, or the HLS playlist and its segments. No token; the secret is the session's.

200.description: The file, a playlist or a segment

206.description: A byte range of the file

post.summary: Watch two to four channels at once
post.description: The server draws the channels into one HLS stream with the sound of one. Offered while the bootstrap's multiview capability is true: with SOFA_MULTIVIEW=auto, only when a GPU encoder works. Each tile holds a playback session, and the stream counts toward SOFA_MAX_TRANSCODES.

patch.summary: Renew the session, or move its sound to another tile
patch.description: A session lasts 60 seconds past its last renewal or media request. Another audio tile restarts the stream under a new epoch.

get.description: The URL the session's descriptor names: the HLS playlist and its segments. No token; the secret is the session's.

get.summary: A sheet of an item's scrub thumbnails
get.description: A path from the item's scrub.sheets, with its ?v= version. Carries Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800.
The path an item names, with its ?v= version. Carries an ETag and Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800.

403.description: The client address is not allowed
The client address is not allowed

get.summary: An MPEG-TS stream of the channel with that lineup number
get.description: While the device's streams are all open, or the source refuses, 503 with X-HDHomeRun-Error: 805 All Tuners In Use.
What a dashboard such as Homepage shows: channels, sessions, recordings, libraries and whether an update is published.

post.summary: Move a live session to its channel's next source
post.description: Passes over the source playing and those the session was switched away from, all of them again once none is left. The session keeps its id and moves to a new epoch: the app re-reads it, and another player's next media request answers 410.

200.description: The session on its new source

get.summary: Ended playback sessions, the newest end first
get.description: Live TV, library files and recordings, one row per session once it ends, kept for SOFA_HISTORY_DAYS days (90 by default).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only sessions that ended at or after this instant

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: A paired device's client id or a player's address

get.summary: The server's events as they happen
get.description: Server-sent events, each named for its type with a JSON object of type, at and data: ready once the stream listens, session.started and session.ended (the data of a history entry), recording.state (a recording's id, title, channel, state and reason), recording.conflict (a recording that newly has no free slot), source.quarantined and source.recovered (an offering's provider and channel), disk.low (free and floor bytes on the recordings disk), update.available (the newer build), library.added (the files a scan added) and attention.changed (the home page's attention items raised and cleared). A comment line every 15 seconds keeps an idle stream open. Nothing is replayed: a client that reconnects reads the history for what it missed.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types to send; all of them without it

schema.description: One event; data is a JSON object of type, at and data

get.summary: Provider channels with their sources and the entries using them

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches the name, the exact number or the tvg-id

get.summary: The XMLTV channels of a guide

post.description: 410 POLICY_MANAGED while a lineup policy builds the lineup.

put.description: 410 POLICY_MANAGED while a lineup policy builds the lineup.

post.summary: Add every channel of a provider that no entry uses
post.description: 410 POLICY_MANAGED while a lineup policy builds the lineup.

patch.description: With a policy, writes the station's override and applies it; If-Match may carry the policy revision.

delete.description: With a policy, writes enabled: false into the station's override instead.

get.summary: The lineup policy the server runs with
get.description: 404 POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED without one. The revision is also the ETag.

put.summary: Replace the policy and apply it
put.description: The body is the whole policy, up to 4 MiB. If-Match is required: 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED without it, 409 POLICY_CHANGED when stale, 400 INVALID_POLICY with every error.

get.summary: What a run would change; writes nothing

post.description: Writes the lineup when it differs, logs each change and writes assigned numbers and learned aliases back to the file.

post.summary: Write the starter policy and restart
post.description: The configured providers in the server's priority order (an HDHomeRun tuner first), the shipped group map and number blocks and health.requireVerified, written to SOFA_POLICY or policy.json in the data directory; the server then restarts to run it. 409 POLICY_EXISTS when a policy is configured or the file exists, 409 NO_SOURCES with no providers.

get.summary: Open findings of a run over the current candidates

get.description: The server keeps the newest 10,000.

get.summary: Why a station key is what it is

get.description: For each station no guide lists by tvg-id, up to three guide channels whose names match its own, best first, in lineup order. Both names lose the policy's guideMatches prefixes and suffixes first. Empty before the first apply.

post.description: Writes the channel as the station's guide override, then applies. 404 GUIDE_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND when the guide does not list the channel.

Accepts each station's best proposal at minConfidence or more, else at the policy's guideMatches.acceptAbove, in one write, then applies once. A station whose best two proposals tie on different channels is skipped.
Adds the proposal to the policy's guideMatches.dismissed, so it is never proposed again, then applies.

get.description: Providers and guides as the file holds them, ${NAME} references unexpanded; an empty document when the server has no source file.

put.summary: Replace the source file and restart
put.description: Validates the document the way the start does (400 INVALID_SOURCES with the reason, nothing written), writes it atomically where the server reads it (SOFA_SOURCES, else sources.json in the data directory) and ends the process once the response is sent; the container's restart policy starts it again. With starterPolicy=true it also writes the starter lineup policy for the document's providers before that one restart (409 POLICY_EXISTS when a policy is configured, 409 NO_SOURCES without providers).

parameters.name: starterPolicy
parameters.description: true also writes the starter policy

put.summary: Save the TMDB token and restart
put.description: Asks TMDB whether it takes the token, stores it as tmdbToken in secrets.json in the data directory and ends the process once the response is sent. 400 INVALID_REQUEST for a value that cannot be a token, 400 TMDB_REJECTED when TMDB refuses it, 502 TMDB_UNREACHABLE when TMDB cannot be asked, 409 TMDB_FROM_ENVIRONMENT when SOFA_TMDB_TOKEN sets it, 500 SECRETS_UNWRITABLE when secrets.json cannot be read or written; nothing is written then. SOFA_TMDB_TOKEN wins over the saved token.

get.description: 404 PLEX_NOT_CONFIGURED when SOFA_PLEX_URL is unset.

post.description: A failure is reported in lastError, not as an error response.

get.description: The addresses from SOFA_HDHR_ALLOW, the ones allowed at run time, and the addresses refused lately.

put.summary: Replace the addresses allowed at run time
put.description: Applies at once with no restart and is kept in the database. SOFA_HDHR_ALLOW still applies beside it. 400 INVALID_REQUEST names an entry that is not an IP literal or CIDR block; nothing changes then.

get.description: In name order.

put.description: Creates the output or replaces the one of that name. The name is lowercased; 400 INVALID_REQUEST for a name that is not 1 to 32 letters, digits and hyphens, for stream, for an output holding no group or channel, or past 32 outputs. A name in the body is ignored.

get.summary: Every client that paired or saved preferences
get.description: Most recently seen first.

delete.summary: Forget a client, its preferences and its token
delete.description: Revokes the token the client was paired with, so it must pair again; a client on SOFA_API_TOKEN keeps working and reappears on its next save.

get.description: Paired devices' api tokens and the read and hook tokens, oldest first, without secrets.

post.summary: Make a read or hook token
post.description: The answer carries the secret this once. Device tokens come only from pairing (400).

get.description: Every notification target in the order it was added, with its newest delivery and without its secret.

post.description: Needs name, kind and url; events defaults to all but the attention items, enabled to true. The URL may be a LAN or loopback address. 400 INVALID_REQUEST names what is wrong.

patch.description: Changes the fields the body gives; an empty secret clears it.

delete.summary: Remove a notification target and its deliveries

post.summary: Send a target a test notification
post.description: Sends the test event once, without retries, and answers how it went; a target that fails still answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The newest first; the server keeps 200 per target.

post.description: Replaces the live code. The code is six digits, live for ten minutes, and spent by the claim that matches it.
